title: Recording: I’m Moving On, Every Man Has A Woman Who Loves Him by John Lennon and Yoko Ono | 1980
content:
Hit Factory, New York City
Producers: John Lennon, Yoko Ono, Jack Douglas
Engineers: Julie Last, Jon Smith

A recording session for John Lennon and Yoko Ono’s Double Fantasy album took place on 16 September 1980.

Lennon and Ono did not attend the session, which lasted from 2-10pm. Arranger Tony Davilio and studio engineers Julie Last and Jon Smith added handclaps and percussion to ‘I’m Moving On’ and ‘Every Man Has A Woman Who Loves Him’.
